properties.name: A claim made by a named party and not yet independently verified reads "claimed (by X, unverified)", not "unproven" or "open", and a claim accepted for a period and later withdrawn reads withdrawn with that period
properties.statement:
@ajs, 2026-10-23: "Go with your recommendations on all of them". This answers my question whether the "claimed by someone, not yet verified" reading goes into PR A2 as a requirement; my recommendation was yes.

A statement that a NAMED PARTY claims to have shown, and that nobody has yet verified independently, reads "claimed by <party>, unverified" in reasoning_report and wherever its truth is printed.
- It never reads "unproven": that word also means refuted, and also means nobody tried.
- It never reads "open", which hides that a claim was made.
- A what-if that drops the claimant's argument returns the statement to open, and leaves everything that does not rest on it standing.

A claim that was ACCEPTED for a period and later WITHDRAWN (Kempe's proof, 1879–1890) reads withdrawn, with the period and what withdrew it. A status that held over a time is read back, not left in dated notes nobody reads.

EVIDENCE:
- The Navier–Stokes map (ad65e4983833f39f): OpenAI's (C) could only read "unproven" (reflow2:fact:the-navier-stokes-map-rung-ran-on-0-90-0-and-a-claim-reads-as-a-claim-but-reflow2-has-no-claimed-reading-2026-10-22, finding (a)).
- The four colour history (7d851f5be7cca068): "accepted 1879–1890, open 1890–1976" lived only in TemporalFacts that no report reads (reflow2:fact:the-four-colour-rung-ran-on-0-90-0-and-one-broken-step-falls-alone-but-a-status-over-time-is-never-read-2026-10-23, finding (a)).

Queued in PR A2 ("proofs and arguments read right", second half). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
